title: Mayor Of Tsingtao - Entertained To Dinner

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.I, Special Branch
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
File No. & REGISTRY.
No. D 5781
Date 4 / 4 / 34
APRIL 4. 1934）
object (in full) Mayor of Tsingtao - entertained to dinner.
Made by D. S. Mac Adie Forwarded by W Duncan DSS
The Mayor of Tsingtao, Sung Hung-lih (沈鴻烈),
was entertained to dinner by the Chinese Chamber of
Commerce and seven other public bodies in the Chamber
on North Soochow Road, between 7.30 p.m. and 8.45 p.m.
April 3. Speeches were made advocating the cooperation
of merchants in Shanghai and Tsingtao for the promotion
of the consumption of national products.
During the past few days the Mayor has visited
the Oppel Electric Bulb Factory, 261 Kueiyang Road,
and several other local Chinese industrial concerns.
R. W. Mac Adie.
D. S.
Officer i/c Special Branch.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
特别科（S.I, Special Branch）
报告
（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处
档案号及登记处编号 D 5781
日期 1934年4月4日
1934年4月4日）
事由（全称）：青岛市长——出席晚宴。
制作人：D. S. Mac Adie 转呈人：W Duncan 副助理总监（DSS）
青岛市长沈鸿烈（Sung Hung-lih）于4月3日晚7时30分至8时45分，在北苏州路商会大楼，由中国商会及其他七个公共团体设宴款待。席间发表演讲，倡导上海与青岛商人合作，以促进国货消费。
在过去几天中，该市长参观了位于贵阳路261号的奥佩尔灯泡厂（Oppel Electric Bulb Factory）以及其他几家本地华商工业企业。
R. W. Mac Adie.
D. S.
特别科主管警官。
归档
HB
